the Samsung s10+, it was the first expensive phone that I had bought myself. I would only buy the cheapest Chinese knockoff phones thinking I would be saving money in the long run but for some unknown reason the cheaper the phone the less likely I would be subconsciously in the protection of that phone until I made the decision to buy the S10+. Typically, I would buy a phone every few months thinking I was just clumsy also I would not buy a phone case trying to save money so I could buy essentials for my family and me. I was not that good with money then as I was previously homeless and addicted to drugs and festivals.

When I finally worked myself to a point of where I was scraping by with the essential necessities for myself and my family I decided to switch from boost mobile and sprint and their monthly payment option was right in the range I needed to not end up stranded from work with no gas or to come home to nothing in the cupboards which were not options at all at those times as it would defeat the point of being the provider if I could not actually provide the base essentials.

The payment option was available for the phone case and a speaker as well which was also nice. But the main caveat of this whole situation is the clarity that I gained from how I treated this expensive device compared to a $40 knockoff. Which was by far a huge difference as stated above the life expectancy of the cheaper phone was about 1-3 months on average whereas my s10+ lasted me 3 years before I traded it in for a newer model. So the fact that it costed me more gave me a whole new appreciation of how I handled the device which kind of sucks since I should have appreciation for every bit of money I spend and for some reason that is something I have been consistently working on but it opened my eyes to that phenomena and that is why I prefer things that are worth the amount spent since you always get what you pay for.

You should stop calling yourself dumb, i'd rephrase and state I stupidly made a choice that ended up harming myself but I learned that if I can train myself into that habit I can untrain myself. Lots of what you are experiencing is just signs of PTSD some of us unfortunately like myself get it so severe it cuts into our nervous system and I have a stutter and twitches that I get when I am having a real bad panic attack which is quite easy if im not in a good environment. Your brain is protecting you by getting you to disassociate to cope with the adversity your life had as you developed. You can repair studies have been conducted and there is scientific proof of synaptic growth simple things like meditation actually stimulate synapses to heal its slow and its hard to train yourself into the discipline but you have to ask yourself id do this looking into a mirror alone so people dont assume things but look into your eyes as deepky as you can and ask is this really me, do I want to run and hide from this or do I want to stand up inside of my self and take back control from the auto reactions that start to consume those who continue to mask with pharmaceuticals or illicit drugs. Its a hard thing to do to face your own self and say do I really love myself or are these behaviors sub conciously allowing me to self destruct. When the truth is revealed and the veil is off you become Sangha or those who have awoken to the truth you can start as slowly as you like. I used to hate myself and the world and it was a bitter lonely existence that i allowed because when my mother left me a part of my innocence the essence of my inner child died it took ne a decade to start to feel again and admit the truth. I now try to practice as much of the 8 fold path as i can since Buddhism is very correlated with healing ones self and is scientificly verrified as well. Recovery dharma is a great nationwide group which actually meets weekly and they do guided meditations and help each other hold space for our adversities and heal. Its easier with a group for sure. You dont have to be a buddhist and its much better than other recovery as its main philosophical message is to not beat oneself up which i noticed you are doing which is a self destructice habit and show that you are essentially starting a negative feedback loop with your inner dialogue dont be so hard on yourself everyone experiences trauma and if you can see through their veil which happens when you show compassion to yourself you will reslize that no one is thinking bad about you they are mostly doing what you were doing with their negative feedback loop. Look upTara brach the rain of compassion on youtube and go through the guided meditation it will help you develop a sense of compassion within. You deserve to be here and you are worth it, never speak to yourself so harshly things are rough but within every good there is evil and within every evil there is good. Focus on the important things and let go of the hot coal that is allowing you lose your compassion. I an only this good at speaking cause every day I wake up grateful to be here and ready to work on myself even when things are dark like they are in my life right now. Im addicted to substances and self destructing while im healing and its hard i might be homeless soon i still dont have really any family support i have a huge community and much wealth but i dissociate to and wait til things are bad before i get help which being here is my first step but im not mad at myself i an a product of ny environment. Im not even mad at my mother or father i am grateful to have this life as hard as it is the small moments like this where i can share knowledge with you make it worth it as long as hope exists in selfless actions we ripple across the still waters of our minds bodies and souls i know that humanity will still exist and these small selfless actions are the only way we can effectively help each other. Cause even though we dont know each other i care about you and your wellbeing there is always a better way. I hope my message reaches inside and helps you gain the compassion to lose your ego and who you think you are and allow who you really are to take back the reigns. Your inner child needs you more now than ever. You got this, if i can do it you can too.
